descriptions.review_with_hold: An order this barrier stops waits for operator review with its funds held. Confirming reruns pre-trade checks without a second hold. The order proceeds if it passes and keeps waiting with its hold if it fails. Canceling releases the hold.
descriptions.reject: An order this barrier stops is refused.
descriptions.review_without_hold: An order this barrier stops waits for operator review. No funds are held and the order stays unsent until confirmation.

enforce.title: Check funds
enforce.description: Refuses an order that needs more funds than the account holds. Switching back to this mode keeps balances as they are, including negative balances, and refuses orders that need funds against them.

review_with_hold.title: Review with hold
review_with_hold.description: An order with insufficient funds waits for operator review. The full amount is held while the order waits, so available funds can go negative. The hold remains in place after confirmation.

review_without_hold.title: Review without hold
review_without_hold.description: An order with insufficient funds waits for operator review without holding funds. After confirmation, the order is accounted for even if available funds go negative.

track_only.title: Accounting without blocking
track_only.description: Orders pass from zero and are accounted; only the refusal for insufficient funds is lifted. Balances and positions may go negative. Accounting and every policy you set - P&L bounds, rate and order size - keep working and still stop trading. Accounting starts from zero - only orders through Officer count; venue positions are not imported.

withoutCurrency.title: P&L bounds block accounts without a currency
withoutCurrency.detail: A P&L bound blocks these accounts because they have no currency, so their P&L cannot be counted. Set a currency on the account or its group.

title: Policies
intro: Relational risk-policy barriers persisted in the control plane and applied to the OpenPit engine per policy. Each row is one barrier for a target.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Check order attributes and submission rate.

approval.title: Confirmation and review
approval.description: Conditions for sending an order to an operator for review.

filter.advancedDescription: Filter by policy kind and numeric barrier values. Account and asset filters stay online in the filter bar.

columnDescriptions.policy: This column shows the risk policy applied by the barrier.
columnDescriptions.scope: This column shows whether the barrier applies globally, to a group, account, asset, or combined target.
columnDescriptions.account: This column shows the account or account group targeted by the barrier when that axis is present.
columnDescriptions.asset: This column shows the asset or account currency targeted by the barrier when that axis is present.
columnDescriptions.values: This column shows the configured numeric or duration values for the policy barrier.
columnDescriptions.actions: This column contains row actions for sharing, editing, and deleting the barrier.

empty.noMatchingHintUnnamed: No barrier matches the current filters.

restartConfirm.title: Rebuild risk engine?
restartConfirm.description: This policy change rebuilds the risk engine from persisted accounts, limits, rules, and balances. Incoming mutating requests are rejected while the rebuild is in progress.

missingAccountConfirm.title: Account does not exist
missingAccountConfirm.description: Account {{account}} does not exist yet. Create it with default settings (no group, no currency) and continue?

dialog.accountCurrencyHint: Currency is taken from the account.
dialog.accountCurrencyMissingHint: The account has no currency. Set a currency on the account or its group before adding a P&L bound.
dialog.pnlAccountBoundsFootnote: At least one P&L bound is required.
dialog.rateLimitFootnote: Both max orders and window are required.
dialog.atLeastOneFootnote: At least one value is required.
dialog.pnlBoundsFootnote: Currency and at least one P&L bound are required.
dialog.fxFailSafeNote: FX fail-safe: an account under P&L control is blocked when a required input is missing, for example an FX quote needed to value realized P&L in the account currency. FX is required only when needed, not for assets already in the account currency and not for accounts outside P&L control.
dialog.positionFailSafeNote: Price fail-safe: an account under P&L control is blocked when a required input is missing, for example the current price of a held asset or an FX quote needed to value the open position in the account currency. FX is required only when needed, not for assets already in the account currency and not for accounts outside P&L control.
